Talent Management Specialist Job at Green Africa Airways Limited




        
    

        
        Green Africa Airways Limited is a value airline based in Lagos, Nigeria. We are a new carrier that offers safe, reliable and affordable air travel to a much broader group of customers. This positions us as a significant contributor to the economic development of Nigeria and the African continent.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Talent Management Specialist

Job Location: Lagos

Job role
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Managing talent acquisition processes and collaborates with departmental managers to understand skills and competences required for job openings
	Updating recruitment procedures and creating new procedures
	Building reports and dashboards to measure recruitment performance
	Overseeing HRIS data management
	Evaluating and suggesting best recruiting software for company needs
	Holding monthly meetings with all operations department leads and outstation visits
	Monitoring key recruitment metrics to identify and resolve issues affecting recruiting procedures
	Maintains knowledge of trends, best practices, regulatory changes, and new technologies in human resources, talent management, and employment law


Qualifications


	Bachelor`s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or any other related disciplines
	2 - 4 years of proven experience in a similar Talent Management role
	Professional certification.


Good to have skills:


	Analytical skills
	Problem solving skills
	Knowledge of social media and professional networks.


Must have skills:


	Excellent verbal and written communication skills
	Excellent interpersonal skills Negotiation, and conflict resolution skills
	Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate
	Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software
	Strong leadership and team management skills.

Our global vision is to be a leading foods company in Africa providing high quality and affordable products in the most convenient ways to consumers through world class brands like Golden Penny Flour, Golden Penny Semovita, Goldenvita, Golden Pasta and Golden Noodles. The Company&#39;s flagship brand, Golden Penny, remains one of the best known and the preferred brands amongst bakers, confectioneries and consumers in Nigeria.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Account Assistant&nbsp;

Job Location: Ibadan, Oyo

Job Purpose


	To support effective expense management and accounts payable operations by ensuring timely processing of vendor invoices, accurate financial record-keeping, prompt payments, and reliable reporting across all business locations.


The Job


	Processing vendor invoices with Purchase Orders (PO) and Goods Received Vouchers (GRV) for the Ibadan Plant.
	Processing vendor invoices without PO/GRV in line with approved policies and procedures.
	Preparing payment schedules and cash disbursement plans using Microsoft Excel.
	Executing vendor payments through the designated banking platform for all company locations.
	Managing vendor accounts and staff IOU accounts to ensure accurate and up-to-date records.
	Performing vendor and bank ledger reconciliations.
	Posting payment-related journal entries and financial transactions into Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365).
	Preparing vendor ageing reports and staff IOU ageing reports for month-end reporting.
	Ensuring daily posting of transactions and maintaining accurate financial records.
	Supporting compliance with internal controls, standard operating procedures, and financial policies.


Qualifications


	Minimum of OND in Accounting or a related discipline.
	Additional accounting certifications or professional qualifications will be an added advantage.


Experience:


	Minimum of 3-4 years of relevant experience in Accounts Payable, Expense Management, or a related finance function.
	Experience using ERP systems, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365), will be an added advantage.


The Person Must have:


	Possess strong numerical and analytical skills.
	Demonstrate excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
	Have a sound understanding of accounts payable processes and expense management.
	Be proficient in Microsoft Excel and accounting software/ERP systems.
	Have good reconciliation and record-management skills.

Account Assistant Job at Flour Mills of Nigeria Plc




        
    

        
        Flour Mills of Nigeria Plc has been a part of the lives of Nigerians at home and abroad. Our global vision is to be a leading foods company in Africa providing high quality and affordable products in the most convenient ways to consumers through world class brands like Golden Penny Flour, Golden Penny Semovita, Goldenvita, Golden Pasta and Golden Noodles. The Company's flagship brand, Golden Penny, remains one of the best known and the preferred brands amongst bakers, confectioneries and consumers in Nigeria.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Account Assistant 

Job Location: Ibadan, Oyo

Job Purpose
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	To support effective expense management and accounts payable operations by ensuring timely processing of vendor invoices, accurate financial record-keeping, prompt payments, and reliable reporting across all business locations.


The Job


	Processing vendor invoices with Purchase Orders (PO) and Goods Received Vouchers (GRV) for the Ibadan Plant.
	Processing vendor invoices without PO/GRV in line with approved policies and procedures.
	Preparing payment schedules and cash disbursement plans using Microsoft Excel.
	Executing vendor payments through the designated banking platform for all company locations.
	Managing vendor accounts and staff IOU accounts to ensure accurate and up-to-date records.
	Performing vendor and bank ledger reconciliations.
	Posting payment-related journal entries and financial transactions into Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365).
	Preparing vendor ageing reports and staff IOU ageing reports for month-end reporting.
	Ensuring daily posting of transactions and maintaining accurate financial records.
	Supporting compliance with internal controls, standard operating procedures, and financial policies.


Qualifications


	Minimum of OND in Accounting or a related discipline.
	Additional accounting certifications or professional qualifications will be an added advantage.


Experience:


	Minimum of 3-4 years of relevant experience in Accounts Payable, Expense Management, or a related finance function.
	Experience using ERP systems, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365), will be an added advantage.


The Person Must have:


	Possess strong numerical and analytical skills.
	Demonstrate excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
	Have a sound understanding of accounts payable processes and expense management.
	Be proficient in Microsoft Excel and accounting software/ERP systems.
	Have good reconciliation and record-management skills.
